stages.name: Germination
stages.tip: Keep soil moist but not waterlogged so seedlings come up evenly.

stages.name: Vegetative
stages.tip: Weed early and scout for leaf-eating caterpillars and yellow patches.

stages.name: Flowering
stages.tip: Water stress now cuts yield. Irrigate if dry and scout for pests every week.

stages.name: Pod filling
stages.tip: Keep moisture even. Watch for pod pests and fungal leaf spots.

stages.name: Maturity
stages.tip: Stop irrigation. Harvest when pods turn yellow-brown and rattle.

stages.name: Seedling
stages.tip: Protect young plants from sucking pests and keep fields weed free.

stages.name: Vegetative
stages.tip: Scout for whitefly, jassids and aphids every week.

stages.name: Squaring and flowering
stages.tip: Avoid water stress. Check squares and flowers for bollworm damage.

stages.name: Boll development
stages.tip: Even moisture matters. Check bolls for pink bollworm.

stages.name: Picking
stages.tip: Pick dry, clean cotton. Remove crop residue after the last picking.

stages.name: Tillering
stages.tip: Crown root stage is critical for irrigation. Follow the local advisory for timing.

stages.name: Jointing
stages.tip: Check for rust and aphids. Apply nutrients as per your soil test.

stages.name: Flowering
stages.tip: Heat and dry spells hurt grain set. Irrigate lightly if hot and dry.

stages.name: Grain filling
stages.tip: Keep moisture even. Watch for rust and heat stress.

stages.name: Maturity
stages.tip: Stop irrigation and plan harvest when grains harden.

stages.name: Establishment
stages.tip: Keep a thin water layer. Check for yellow or stunted seedlings.

stages.name: Tillering
stages.tip: Manage weeds and nitrogen as per soil test. Watch for stem borer.

stages.name: Panicle initiation
stages.tip: Keep fields moist. Scout for blast and bacterial leaf blight.

stages.name: Flowering
stages.tip: Avoid water stress and spraying during flowering hours.

stages.name: Grain filling
stages.tip: Drain the field before harvest as advised locally.

stages.name: Emergence
stages.tip: Check stand count and fill gaps early.

stages.name: Vegetative
stages.tip: Scout for fall armyworm in the whorl every few days.

stages.name: Tasseling and silking
stages.tip: Water stress now causes poor grain set. Irrigate if dry.

stages.name: Grain filling
stages.tip: Keep moisture even and watch for cob pests and leaf blight.

stages.name: Maturity
stages.tip: Harvest when husks dry and grains harden.

stages.name: Seedling
stages.tip: Harden seedlings and avoid waterlogging.

stages.name: Vegetative
stages.tip: Stake plants and scout for whitefly and leaf curl signs.

stages.name: Flowering and fruit set
stages.tip: Hot or very humid spells reduce fruit set and raise blight risk.

stages.name: Fruiting
stages.tip: Keep leaves dry where possible. Watch for blight and fruit borer.

stages.name: Harvest
stages.tip: Harvest regularly and remove diseased fruit and leaves.
